verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

trs.20: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197316>1</sup>
trs.85: Ha Mim
trs.22: Ha-Mim
trs.203: Hâ-Mîm.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

trs.20: By the clear Book,
trs.85: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
trs.22: By the Book that makes things clear,-
trs.203: By the manifest Book (i.e. this Qur’ân that makes things clear).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
trs.85: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so that you [people] may understand.
trs.22: We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
trs.203: Verily, We have made it a Qur’ân in Arabic that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

trs.20: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book<sup foot_note=197318>1</sup> with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.<sup foot_note=197317>2</sup>
trs.85: It is truly exalted in the Source of Scripture kept with Us, and full of wisdom.
trs.22: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom.
trs.203: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is in the Mother of the Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz), with Us, indeed exalted, full of wisdom.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ

trs.20: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
trs.85: Should We ignore you and turn this revelation away from you because you are insolent people?
trs.22: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds?
trs.203: Shall We then (warn you not and) take away the Reminder (this Qur’ân) from you, because you are a people Musrifûn.<sup foot_note=154890>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
trs.85: We have sent many a prophet to earlier people
trs.22: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old?
trs.203: And how many a Prophet have We sent amongst the men of old.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

trs.20: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
trs.85: and they mocked every one of them,
trs.22: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
trs.203: And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: And We destroyed greater than them<sup foot_note=197319>1</sup> in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
trs.85: so We have destroyed mightier people than [the disbelievers of Mecca] and their example has gone down in history.
trs.22: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old.
trs.203: Then We destroyed men stronger (in power) than these - and the example of the ancients has passed away (before them).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
trs.85: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to say, ‘They were created by the Almighty, the All Knowing.’
trs.22: If thou wert to question them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would be sure to reply, 'they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge';-
trs.203: And indeed if you ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them."

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
trs.85: It is He who smoothed out the earth for you and traced out routes on it for you to find your way,
trs.22: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way);
trs.203: Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

trs.20: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
trs.85: who sends water down from the sky in due measure––We resurrect dead land with it, and likewise you will be resurrected from the grave––
trs.22: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead);-
trs.203: And Who sends down water (rain) from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth (from the graves).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

trs.20: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
trs.85: who created every kind of thing, who gave you ships and animals to ride on
trs.22: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride,
trs.203: And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride:

verses.text_uthmani: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ

trs.20: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.<sup foot_note=197320>1</sup>
trs.85: so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on them and say, ‘Glory be to Him who has given us control over this; we could not have done it by ourselves.
trs.22: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves),
trs.203: In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the Favour of your Lord when you mount thereon, and say: "Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it (by our efforts).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

trs.20: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
trs.85: Truly it is to our Lord that we are returning.’
trs.22: "And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!"
trs.203: And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.<sup foot_note=197321>1</sup> Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
trs.85: Yet they assign some of His own servants to Him as offspring!Man is clearly ungrateful!
trs.22: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed!
trs.203: Yet, they assign to some of His slaves a share with Him (by pretending that He has children, and considering them as equals or co-partners in worship with Him). Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate!

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ

trs.20: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
trs.85: Has He taken daughters for Himself and favoured you with sons?
trs.22: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice?
trs.203: Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons?

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

trs.20: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
trs.85: When one of them is given news of the birth of a daughter, such as he so readily ascribes to the Lord of Mercy, his face grows dark and he is filled with gloom-
trs.22: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (Allah) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief!
trs.203: And if one of them is informed of the news of (the birth of a girl) that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious (Allâh), his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief!

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ

trs.20: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident<sup foot_note=197322>1</sup> [attributed to Allāh]?
trs.85: ‘Someone who is brought up amongst trinkets, who cannot put together a clear argument?’
trs.22: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with Allah)?
trs.203: (Like they then for Allâh) a creature who is brought up in adornments (wearing silk and gold ornaments, i.e. women), and who in dispute cannot make herself clear?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ

trs.20: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
trs.85: They consider the angels- God’s servants- to be female. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned about it.
trs.22: And they make into females angels who themselves serve Allah. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account!
trs.203: And they make the angels who themselves are slaves of the Most Gracious (Allâh) females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned!

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

trs.20: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
trs.85: They say, ‘If the Lord of Mercy had willed it, we would not have worshipped them,’ but they do not know that- they are only guessing-
trs.22: ("Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (Allah) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie!
trs.203: And they said: "If it had been the Will of the Most Gracious (Allâh), we should not have worshipped them (false deities)." They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do nothing but lie!

translation.text: we would not have worshipped them
we would not have worshipped them

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

trs.20: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
trs.85: or have We perhaps given them a book before this one, to which they hold fast?
trs.22: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast?
trs.203: Or have We given them any Book before this (the Qur’ân) to which they are holding fast?

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
trs.85: No indeed! They say, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are guided by their footsteps.’
trs.22: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps."
trs.203: Nay! They say: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps."

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

trs.20: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
trs.85: When-ever We sent a messenger before you to warn a township, those corrupted by wealth said, in the same way, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are only following in their footsteps.’
trs.22: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps."
trs.203: And similarly, We sent not a warner before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

trs.20: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
trs.85: The messenger said, ‘Even though I bring you a truer religion than what you saw your fathers following?’ and they replied, ‘But we do not believe the message you bring.’
trs.22: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
trs.203: (The warner) said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

trs.20: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
trs.85: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
trs.22: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
trs.203: So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who denied (Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

trs.20: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
trs.85: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
trs.22: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
trs.203: And (remember) when Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ

trs.20: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
trs.85: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
trs.22: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
trs.203: "Except Him (i.e. I worship none but Allâh Alone) Who did create me; and verily He will guide me."

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: And he made it<sup foot_note=197323>1</sup> a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
trs.85: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
trs.22: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah).
trs.203: And he made it [i.e. Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh Alone)] a Word lasting among his offspring, (True Monotheism), that they may turn back (i.e. to repent to Allâh or receive admonition).

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers<sup foot_note=197325>1</sup> until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.<sup foot_note=197324>2</sup>
trs.85: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-
trs.22: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
trs.203: Nay, but I gave (the good things of this life) to these (polytheists) and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth (the Qur’ân), and a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) making things clear.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

trs.20: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
trs.85: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
trs.22: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
trs.203: And when the truth (this Qur’ân) came to them, they (the disbelievers in this Qur’ân) said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

trs.20: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"<sup foot_note=197326>1</sup>
trs.85: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
trs.22: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
trs.203: And they say: "Why is not this Qur’ân sent down to some great man of the two towns (Makkah and Tâ’if)?"

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

trs.20: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
trs.85: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.
trs.22: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
trs.203: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy (Paradise) of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) is better than the (wealth of this world) which they amass.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

trs.20: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers],<sup foot_note=197327>1</sup> We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
trs.85: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,
trs.22: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
trs.203: And were it not that mankind would have become of one community (all disbelievers, desiring worldly life only), We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious (Allâh), silver roofs for their houses, and elevators whereby they ascend,

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

trs.20: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
trs.85: massive gates, couches to sit on,
trs.22: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
trs.203: And for their houses, doors (of silver), and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

trs.20: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
trs.85: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
trs.22: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
trs.203: And adornments of gold. Yet all this (i.e. the roofs, doors, stairs, elevators, thrones of their houses) would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is (only) for the Muttaqûn.<sup foot_note=154891>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ

trs.20: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
trs.85: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
trs.22: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
trs.203: And whosoever turns away blindly from the remembrance of the Most Gracious (Allâh) (i.e. this Qur’ân and worship of Allâh), We appoint for him Shaitan (Satan - devil) to be a Qarîn (a companion) to him.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
trs.85: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
trs.22: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
trs.203: And verily, they (Satans / devils) hinder them from the Path (of Allâh), but they think that they are guided aright!

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ

trs.20: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
trs.85: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
trs.22: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
trs.203: Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says [to his Qarîn (Satan / devil companion)] "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west)" - a worst (type of) companion (indeed)!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

trs.20: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
trs.85: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
trs.22: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
trs.203: It will profit you not this Day (O you who turn away from Allâh’s remembrance and His worship) as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers (you and your Qarîn ) in the punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
trs.85: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
trs.22: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
trs.203: Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

trs.20: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
trs.85: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
trs.22: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
trs.203: And even if We take you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

trs.20: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
trs.85: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
trs.22: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
trs.203: Or (if) We show you that wherewith We threaten them: then verily We have perfect command over them.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

trs.20: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
trs.85: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
trs.22: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
trs.203: So hold you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) fast to that which is revealed to you. Verily you are on the Straight Path.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, it is a remembrance<sup foot_note=197328>1</sup> for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
trs.85: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
trs.22: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
trs.203: And verily this (the Qur’ân) is indeed a Reminder for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and your people (Quraish people, or your followers), and you will be questioned (about it).

verses.text_uthmani: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

trs.20: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
trs.85: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
trs.22: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
trs.203: And ask (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) those of Our Messengers whom We sent before you: "Did We ever appoint âlihâh (gods) to be worshipped besides the Most Gracious (Allâh)?"

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
trs.85: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
trs.22: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
trs.203: And indeed We did send Mûsâ (Moses) with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs (inviting them to Allâh’s religion of Islâm) He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

trs.20: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
trs.85: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
trs.22: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
trs.203: But when he came to them with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations) behold, they laughed at them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
trs.85: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
trs.22: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
trs.203: And not an Ayâh (sign, etc.) We showed them but it was greater than its fellow , and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn [from their polytheism to Allâh’s religion (Islâmic Monotheism)].

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
trs.85: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
trs.22: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
trs.203: And they said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has covenanted with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves (aright)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

trs.20: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
trs.85: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
trs.22: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
trs.203: But when We removed the torment from them, behold, they broke their covenant (that they will believe if We remove the torment from them).

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
trs.85: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?
trs.22: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
trs.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

trs.20: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?<sup foot_note=197329>1</sup>
trs.85: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
trs.22: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
trs.203: "Am I not better than this one [Mûsâ (Moses)] who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly?

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

trs.20: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
trs.85: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
trs.22: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
trs.203: "Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

trs.20: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
trs.85: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
trs.22: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
trs.203: Thus he [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] befooled (and misled) his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
trs.85: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
trs.22: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
trs.203: So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all.

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

trs.20: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
trs.85: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
trs.22: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
trs.203: And We made them a precedent (as a lesson for those coming after them), and an example to later generations.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

trs.20: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example,<sup foot_note=197330>1</sup> immediately your people laughed aloud.
trs.85: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
trs.22: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
trs.203: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols], behold, your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

trs.20: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"<sup foot_note=197331>1</sup> They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
trs.85: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
trs.22: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
trs.203: And say: "Are our âlihah (gods) better or is he [‘Îsâ (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. (See V. 21:98-101)

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

trs.20: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
trs.85: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
trs.22: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
trs.203: He [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

trs.20: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another]<sup foot_note=197332>1</sup> on the earth.
trs.85: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
trs.22: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
trs.203: And if it were Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsir At-Tabarî].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

trs.20: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.<sup foot_note=197333>1</sup> This is a straight path.
trs.85: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
trs.22: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
trs.203: And he [‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. ‘Isâ’s (Jesus) descent on the earth].<sup foot_note=154892>1</sup> Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allâh) (i.e. be obedient to Allâh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islâmic Monotheism, leading to Allâh and to His Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
trs.85: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
trs.22: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
trs.203: And let not Shaitân (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

trs.20: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
trs.85: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:
trs.22: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
trs.203: And when ‘Îsâ (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) in which you differ. Therefore fear Allâh and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

trs.20: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
trs.85: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
trs.22: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
trs.203: "Verily, Allâh! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allâh’s religion of true Islâmic Monotheism)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

trs.20: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
trs.85: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
trs.22: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
trs.203: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong [by ascribing things to ‘Îsâ (Jesus) that are not true] from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

trs.20: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
trs.85: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
trs.22: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
trs.203: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly, while they perceive not?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

trs.20: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
trs.85: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
trs.22: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
trs.203: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

trs.20: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
trs.85: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
trs.22: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
trs.203: (It will be said to the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

trs.20: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
trs.85: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
trs.22: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
trs.203: (You) who believed in Our Ayât (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allâh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

trs.20: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,<sup foot_note=197334>1</sup> delighted."
trs.85: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
trs.22: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
trs.203: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.

verses.text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
trs.85: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:
trs.22: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
trs.203: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
trs.85: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
trs.22: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
trs.203: This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world).

verses.text_uthmani: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: For you therein is much fruit<sup foot_note=197335>1</sup> from which you will eat.
trs.85: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
trs.22: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
trs.203: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
trs.85: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
trs.22: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
trs.203: Verily, the Mujrimûn (criminals, sinners, disbelievers) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

trs.20: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
trs.85: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
trs.22: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
trs.203: (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
trs.85: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
trs.22: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
trs.203: We wronged them not, but they were the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ

trs.20: And they will call, "O Mālik,<sup foot_note=197336>1</sup> let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
trs.85: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
trs.22: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
trs.203: And they will cry: "O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever."

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

trs.20: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
trs.85: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
trs.22: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
trs.203: Indeed We have brought the truth (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم with the Qur’ân) to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth.<sup foot_note=154893>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

trs.20: Or have they devised [some] affair?<sup foot_note=197337>1</sup> But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
trs.85: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
trs.22: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
trs.203: Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

trs.20: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
trs.85: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
trs.22: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
trs.203: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? (Yes We do) and Our messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."<sup foot_note=197338>1</sup>
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
trs.22: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "If the Most Gracious (Allâh) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allâh’s worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allâh Alone and testify that He has no children)]." [Tafsir At-Tabarî].

verses.text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
trs.85: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
trs.22: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
trs.203: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
trs.85: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
trs.22: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
trs.203: So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
trs.85: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
trs.22: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
trs.203: It is He (Allâh) Who is the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He be the All-Wise, the All-Knower.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
trs.85: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.
trs.22: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
trs.203: And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: And those they invoke<sup foot_note=197340>1</sup> besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.<sup foot_note=197339>2</sup>
trs.85: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
trs.22: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
trs.203: And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession - except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allâh, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allâh).<sup foot_note=154894>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

trs.20: And if you asked them<sup foot_note=197341>1</sup> who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
trs.85: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
trs.22: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
trs.203: And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: "Allâh." How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allâh, Who created them)?

verses.text_uthmani: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying,<sup foot_note=197342>1</sup> "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
trs.85: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
trs.22: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
trs.203: (And Allâh has the knowledge) of (Prophet Muhammad’s) saying: "O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."<sup foot_note=197343>1</sup> But they are going to know.
trs.85: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
trs.22: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
trs.203: So turn away from them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), and say: Salâm (peace)! But they will come to know.<sup foot_note=154895>1</sup>
